messages.subject: Source-ready integration complete
messages.body: Implemented the owned native-volume integration fixes across schema, engine, train router, checkpoint/resume, historical compatibility, and tests, and sent the source-ready handoff to Astra. Owned verification passes with 24 targeted tests plus repository checks, including real fixture L/U training, strict accumulation, auxiliary support weighting, exact resume, and historical student/EMA loading. The latest full suite is 328 passed, 1 failed, 1 warning because of an outside-owner correction test mismatch; no GPU or patient training was run, and remaining integration notes are recorded in the report.

messages.subject: Eval scoring ignores contradictory reference-mask affine metadata
messages.body: Final eval negative probe: add affine_xyz_to_world_mm with +1000mm translation to each manufactured evaluation mask item (same valid NPY/hash/shape), repin manifest+sidecar, evaluate_manifest(...allow_labels=True,synthetic=True) still returns labels_read2 and FROZEN_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY. evaluation.py:278-287 checks only mask shape/ontology and ignores affine/source/frame metadata; _evaluation_records physical NIfTI checks masks=None. Please have eval owner reject unsupported contradictory mask metadata or validate explicit native-mask geometry/frame provenance after freezing predictions; shape equality alone cannot prove alignment. Positive no-label probe replaced mask paths with nonexistent files and image-only evaluation still returned labels_read0, so image-only isolation passes.

messages.subject: Correction owner fixes and regressions complete
messages.body: Resolved C1-C4 review blockers by enforcing pre-access allowlist simulation authorization (TRAIN-L budget or synthetic fixture), preserving untouched unknown 255 and prior manual edits across iterative rounds, converting NIfTI meter affines to mm with strict grid matching, and implementing independent .npz/.nii.gz exports alongside an explicitly callable I01 interactive protocol. All 35 unit/regression/CLI tests and full volume suite pass, with zero mask opens verified on forbidden roles via I/O spies and 100% agreement on Astra's adversarial checks. Real patient training and target GPU benchmarks remain unexecuted by contract because cloud PRO4000 hardware is not currently rented.

messages.subject: Temporal failclosed limit: flat nonzero images accepted as observable motion
messages.body: Additional reproducible temporal limit in cf24a302: register_volumes(torch.ones(1,1,3,16,16),same,config={mode:motion,slice_wise:False}) accepts768 voxels with identity-like flow2.3e-9; support apodization itself creates the phase peak although image content is spatially constant and motion unobservable. Task requires unsupported situations fail closed and identity only named diagnostic/verified fixtures. Add contrast/phase observability check on valid image content before apodization (constant all-one case, not only zero/empty support). Otherwise document as unresolved acceptance gap; simple dx2/global and fractional-support tests now pass.
